domain.text: devtooling: agent-orchestration CLI (vmethod merge-task / worker adopt / git identity / self-hosting)

impressions.text: Domain is developer tooling for agent workflow orchestration: PR #38 fixes the merge-task post-merge follow-up, adds orchestrator-only worker session adoption, passes the four explicit git identity variables through the gateway runner, and accepts the built dist/vmethod.mjs for self-hosting worker start, answering the five problems raised in issue #37.

The codexbal/gpt-6.1-sol worker delivered all five problems plus both amendments in a single round, reporting that each problem's regression test failed before its fix and that the full local check (433 tests plus format, lint, typecheck, build, smoke, knip) passed with green CI.

The orchestrator independently verified the fix live against the real repo and opencode server — merge-task 36 on an already-merged PR now completes the follow-up, worker adopt recorded the PR's own bootstrap session, and check raised no identity finding — before requesting owner approval of the pinned head f027b2a.

Strengths shown include the milestone of first real use of vmethod's own push and wait-checks commands, with neither fallback needed; the only recorded downside signal is the estimate moving from 3 points open to 5 points final.

No stops, escalations, review catches, stalls, or prompt defects are stated anywhere in the thread or record; the flow is a straightforward worker READY FOR REVIEW, orchestrator OWNER REVIEW verification, and a merged outcome the same day.

findings.text: Milestone: PR #38 marks the first real use of vmethod's own push (37-merge-followup at f027b2a) and wait-checks (38, checks green) commands, and neither fallback was needed.
